Overall verdict before editing: the plan was already cautious and most recommendations carried a source tag; the problems were (a) several sentences worded as facts although their tag pointed to a snippet or memory, (b) two factual errors, (c) a few missing rule-related cautions, (d) phone-feasibility gaps.

VERDICT PER RECOMMENDATION (basis). Supported by something read or measured: accurate keyword-first titles and simple thumbnails (read: youtube.com/creators/grow/optimize-your-content/); no notifications/comments so no launch-day tactics (read: youtube.com/myfamily/); two-step verification and channel review before admission (read: youtube.com/creators/earn/overview/ and /howyoutubeworks/our-policies/); thumbnail/title refresh keeps views (read, same creators page); production order Banyo > Alfabe > Meyve-Sebze > Gezegenler > Sayilar and upload order with El Yikama first (measured search-page data, single snapshot); compilation length arithmetic 9 min 35 s / 7 min 43 s and long episode 10 min 04 s (I re-measured: 575.1 s, 463.5 s, 603.6 s). Supported only by snippet or memory: end screens/cards/watermark/save-to-playlist off (snippet, support.google.com/youtube/answer/9632097); quality principles and 'deceptively educational' (snippet, answer/10774223); inauthentic-content rule (snippet, answer/1311392 and press); 8,000-hour threshold from 1 Feb 2027 (snippet, blog.youtube post); AI disclosure not reducing reach and cartoon exemption (snippet, answer/14328491); no application for YouTube Kids (snippet, answer/10938174); Shorts not counting to watch hours (snippet, answer/72851); phone verification for custom thumbnails, 1280x720/2 MB thumbnail spec, 'legal duty' of the audience setting, fake-engagement consequences (memory). Unsupported (now labelled as assumption/experiment in the plan): 'watch hours come from long videos', three videos on day one, compilation in week 4, same weekday every week, fast opening helps retention, sharing the playlist link, text-free thumbnails, Shorts trial.

kalan_riskler: Help Center facts remain unverified. support.google.com, blog.youtube and www.youtubekids.com were unreachable again in this review, so the full disabled-feature list, the kids quality principles, the inauthentic-content rule, the 1 February 2027 threshold (8,000 hours), the AI-disclosure exemptions and whether AI-generated music itself requires disclosure are known only from search summaries or memory. They should be read on the official pages once those hosts are allowed, and certainly before any Partner Programme application.
Whether YouTube Kids is offered in Turkiye, and whether the channel will be included, is unverified (memory only). The day-8 check may simply not be possible.

Ali Baba'nin Ciftligi: the copyright status of the Turkish lyrics is unverified (the setup guide notes sources attributing them to a composer who died in 1977, which would still be inside the protection period if true). The plan schedules it on day 1 if the owner decides so; that contradicts the project's own rule in ICERIK-LISTESI.md and could bring a copyright claim. This is the largest rule risk in the launch set and is an owner decision.
Commercial-use terms of the AI music, image and video tools were not checked in this review; if a plan does not grant commercial rights, monetisation could be affected.

Nobody has confirmed how the songs sound. The assistant cannot hear; the Balon song's lyrics are unknown, so its 'Renkler Sarkisi' title is conditional; El Yikama intelligibility is unchecked. The quality rule aimed at unintelligible auto-generated audio is exactly the failure this could hit. The plan relies on the owner listening to every video before making it public.

Inauthentic / mass-produced content risk stays real and vague: an AI-made 3D kitten nursery-rhyme channel in a niche where several small channels recently published near-identical kitten-family songs. Mitigations in the plan (own scenes per song, one compilation, linking scenes) are reasonable but there is no way to test them before a programme review.

No lever in the plan is proven to raise views for this channel. Search is mostly closed for the seven songs, the compilation is not expected to rank, playlist and Up next effects are assumptions, and autoplay is off by default for kid accounts. Near-zero views for the first weeks are a likely outcome; the first real evidence is the day-28 review.

Phone feasibility is untested: channel-level made-for-kids setting, channel keywords, the AI question, tags and playlist selection may not all exist in the YouTube Studio phone app; the fallback (studio.youtube.com as desktop site in the phone browser) is from memory and was not tried. The retention graph and per-video click-through rate may also not display at very low view counts.

The audit tags in the plan (denetim-k1...k15, v1...v7) could not be traced to a written report: /home/user/ring-tokat-3d/cocuk-kanali/buyume/denetim contains only olcum.csv, frames and tools. The setup guide /home/user/ring-tokat-3d/cocuk-kanali/kanal-kurulum/KANAL-KURULUM.md still contains the old seven titles, the old upload order and 'two videos a week', and KANAL-STRATEJISI.md still says 4,000 hours and two Shorts a week. arastirma_ozetleri.ozet:
Scope and limits. Only www.youtube.com was reachable from this session (with curl; WebFetch could not resolve it). support.google.com, blog.youtube, services.google.com and all news sites failed, so Help Center wording, the July 2026 inauthentic-content clarification and the February 2027 Partner Programme change are known only through search summaries and should be confirmed once support.google.com and blog.youtube are allowed in the session's network settings. Nine official pages were read in full and their text is saved in /home/user/ring-tokat-3d/cocuk-kanali/buyume/arastirma-kurallar/kaynak-metinler/ (index: /home/user/ring-tokat-3d/cocuk-kanali/buyume/arastirma-kurallar/kaynak-metinler/KAYNAKLAR.txt). No existing file was changed.

What is established. (1) Made for kids removes comments, notifications and personalised ads (read), and per the Help Center summary also end screens, cards, watermark, miniplayer, save-to-playlist, Super Chat and community posts. (2) What remains is search, Up next beside other kids' videos, the channel's own playlists, the YouTube Kids app and long TV/tablet sessions. (3) YouTube states that kids quality principles feed the recommendation system and that all made-for-kids content in YouTube Kids must meet them (read); the Help Center summary adds that low-quality kids channels can be recommended less, removed from YouTube Kids and suspended from the Partner Programme. There is no application for YouTube Kids. (4) AI use is allowed and disclosure does not reduce reach; disclosure is mandatory only for realistic-looking content, and YouTube may label videos itself (read). The real risk for an AI-made kids channel is the 'mass-produced / template / repetitive' monetisation rule and the quality principle on incoherent auto-generated videos. (5) Official advice on titles, thumbnails and schedule is modest: accurate titles with keywords early, simple readable thumbnails, a sustainable schedule (read). (6) Thresholds: 500 subscribers + 3 uploads + 3,000 hours for the early tier (read, but of little use to a kids channel); ad revenue needs 1,000 subscribers + 4,000 hours now and, per the announcement summaries, 8,000 hours for applications from 1 February 2027.

Not established. Whether made-for-kids Shorts appear in YouTube Kids or get normal Shorts-feed distribution; whether YouTube Kids is offered in Türkiye (I believe so, unverified); whether thumbnail testing works on made-for-kids videos; the exact 'active channel' figures in the 2027 terms.

Points where the existing plan needs correcting: KANAL-STRATEJISI.md section 7 quotes 4,000 hours (plan for 8,000); section 2 schedules two Shorts a week for discovery (unproven, and Shorts views do not count toward watch hours).

Keyword and title research is done for all 12 videos, with one caveat up front: it measures how crowded page one is today, not how often a phrase is searched (autocomplete is blocked, so search volume is unknown).

I fetched 55 Turkish search pages once, logged out, on 2026-11-21 (1,019 video rows, 307 channels, subscriber counts for 279). Titles, tags and the plain-language notes for the owner are in Turkish in `oneriler-baslik-etiket.csv`; the evidence is in `kanit-sorgu-ozeti.csv` and `kanit-arama-sonuclari.csv`, all in `/home/user/ring-tokat-3d/cocuk-kanali/buyume/arastirma-kelimeler/`.

- **Hopeless head phrases for a new channel:** parmak ailesi (şarkısı), baba parmak şarkısı, otobüs şarkısı, otobüsün tekerlekleri dönüyor, hayvan sesleri şarkısı, gezegenler şarkısı, güneş sistemi şarkısı, alfabe şarkısı alone, harfler şarkısı, sayılar şarkısı, sayıları öğreniyorum, sayma şarkısı, pazara gidelim şarkısı. Medians run from 5M to 28M views with no or almost no small channels in the top 10.
- **Winnable or loose phrases:** el yıkama şarkısı (4 channels under 10K subscribers in the top 10), ali babanın çiftliği hayvan sesleri, ali babanın bir çiftliği var, kedi ailesi şarkısı, aile şarkısı çocuk, aile üyeleri şarkısı, 29 harf şarkısı, banyo şarkısı. Medium: renkler şarkısı, çiftlik hayvanları şarkısı, sebzeler şarkısı, abc şarkısı türkçe.
- **The catch:** where page one is weak, the small videos that rank there also have few views (often 2K to 30K after most of a year), so those phrases probably bring little traffic. Search will add only a little for the seven existing songs; that inference is mine, not measured.
- **The exception:** "banyo şarkısı", where a 1:42 song from a 2.26K-subscriber channel is #1 with 3.1M views in 10 months.
- **Production order (owner decision):** on this evidence Banyo should come first, then Alfabe with "29 harf", then Meyve ve Sebzeler, with Gezegenler and Sayılar last. The content list currently schedules Gezegenler and Sayılar next month; I did not change it.
